eras.name: Flybys and first orbiters
eras.summary: Mariner 4 sends the first close pictures; Mariner 9 becomes the first spacecraft to orbit another planet and maps Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris.
eras.summary_zh: 水手4号拍下第一批近距离照片；水手9号成为首个环绕其他行星的航天器，绘出奥林匹斯山与水手号峡谷。

eras.name: The Viking years
eras.summary: Two Viking landers touch down and search the soil for life; their orbiters map the whole planet.
eras.summary_zh: 两台海盗号着陆器登陆，在土壤里寻找生命；轨道器绘出全球地图。

eras.name: The first rovers
eras.summary: Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity roam the surface and find signs that water once flowed.
eras.summary_zh: 旅居者号、勇气号与机遇号在地表行驶，找到昔日流水的痕迹。

eras.name: Mobile laboratories
eras.summary: Curiosity and Perseverance carry whole laboratories; China's Zhurong lands in Utopia Planitia and Ingenuity makes the first powered flight on another world.
eras.summary_zh: 好奇号与毅力号带着整座实验室；中国祝融号登陆乌托邦平原，机智号完成首次地外动力飞行。
